topSignals.title: Bloom Energy's post-S&P-500 rally is sharply diverging from its SOFC peers.
topSignals.text: BE is up 38% over the past month (YTD +220%), closing Sept 22 at $277.81 (+1.63%) on continued passive-fund index-rebalancing flow. Over the same month FuelCell Energy fell 8% to $17.93 and Plug Power fell 7% to $2.10, while GE Vernova was roughly flat. Bulls argue index inclusion permanently narrows Bloom's tradeable float toward patient passive holders; bears call it a one-time mechanical flow that could reverse if Q3 earnings (Oct 27) disappoint. 24/7 Wall St.

topSignals.title: Ceres Power's H1 2026 results are due today, Sept 23, before UK market open
topSignals.text: — consensus expects a loss of £0.0644/share on revenue of ~$34.75M. Not yet published at the time of writing; last year's H1 comparable (Sept 2025) showed revenue down 26% YoY to £21.1M with Doosan's SOFC mass-production ramp and Delta Electronics' ~£170M Taiwan manufacturing commitment as the strategic highlights. Defense World

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new news beyond Top Signal #2. Standing status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform, ELCO I Tallinn factory ramping toward 360 MW/yr.

Topsoe (priority): No new news — seventh consecutive quiet day (Top Signal #2). SOEC-only Herning factory (500 MW/yr) remains the flagship asset; SOFC/data-center pathway still deferred under the May 2026 roadmap review.
Ceres Power: H1 2026 results due today before market open — see Top Signal #3.
No new stack/cell announcements found from Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, or Aisin in the last 24-48h.
Bloom Energy (BE): Close Sept 22: $277.81 (+1.63%) — see Top Signal #1. Up 38% over the past month, YTD +220%. Securities class-action lead-plaintiff deadline still Sept 28; Q3 earnings Oct 27.

FuelCell Energy (FCEL): Closed Sept 22 at $17.93, down ~8% over the past month. A wave of plaintiff-firm press releases reminded investors of the Nov 10, 2026 lead-plaintiff deadline — routine litigation marketing, no new substantive disclosure. Backlog remains $3.6B.
Ceres Power (CWR.L): H1 2026 results due today before market open — see Top Signal #3.

lcoe.text: No new capex/opex/efficiency figures today. Henry Hub carry-forward unchanged: EIA's full-year 2026 average estimate remains ~$3.43-3.44/MMBtu, still below the model's carried $4.00-4.30/MMBtu assumption.

EPA turbine NSPS (background, in force since Jan 15, 2026): exempts "low-use" combustion turbines from major-source Title V permitting for data centers — eases the permitting case for competing gas-turbine on-site power; under legal challenge over the "temporary" turbine loophole. Clark Hill

Pending calendar: Ceres H1 results (today, Sept 23), Germany EEG-Novelle first Bundestag reading (Sept 24), Bloom lead-plaintiff deadline (Sept 28), PJM backstop bid window (Sept 30-Oct 21), Bloom Q3 earnings (Oct 27), FCEL lead-plaintiff deadline (Nov 10).
